final_message:
`satisfies` and `maxSatisfying` are implemented in `src/range.ts`, and `npm test` passes all 3 tests.

I also ran about 60 extra cases from the README against the implementation, covering partial versions, every operator, hyphen ranges, `||` alternatives, and the error cases. All of them behave as specified. I didn't run a type check because `tsc` isn't installed and npm couldn't fetch it.

Implementation notes:
- Ranges are fully parsed before any version is checked, so a bad comparator in a later set throws even when an earlier set would match.
- `maxSatisfying` validates every version in the list, including ones that don't match, and returns the original string.
- Version numbers are parsed with `Number`, which is exact only up to 2^53. Very large version components would compare incorrectly; I didn't add BigInt handling.
